items.title: Fed holds rates, says data will guide next move
items.summary: In their latest meeting, Federal Reserve officials decided to keep interest rates steady, reflecting a measured approach towards inflation concerns. Not all agreed, however; two officials pushed for an increase to counteract growing prices. Current economic indicators reveal robust growth, driven by increased consumer spending and investment. Analysts are keenly awaiting upcoming inflation data to better gauge the…

items.title: Lab Rats series: Unlocking the kidney for therapy with Helex
items.summary: Hyderabad-based Helex Inc is working on a first-in-class mechanism to deliver gene editing drugs safely into the kidneys—a massive medical challenge currently. They not only want to do it first, but also develop it to be affordable for most Indians.

items.title: Union Cabinet approves ₹10,000 crore Container Manufacturing Scheme to boost India's production
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved significant schemes to enhance India's manufacturing infrastructure and capacity. The ₹10,000 crore Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme aims to increase container production substantially by 2040. Additionally, the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana will be implemented from 2026-27 to 2030-31, providing crucial funding. The Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme will…

items.title: Government extends PLI scheme for textiles until 2033-34 to boost MSME participation and investments
items.summary: The government has announced an extension of the Production Linked Incentive scheme for the textiles sector until 2034. This change aims to encourage more companies to participate by relaxing eligibility norms for investment. The textiles ministry has reduced the minimum turnover requirement for certain manufacturers from ₹200 crore to ₹100 crore. A reopened application portal will accept submissions for…

items.title: Union cabinet approves 3% DA hike for 11.6 million central employees and pensioners, effective July 1
items.summary: On Wednesday, the Union cabinet approved a 3% increase in dearness allowance for employees and pensioners. This increase is expected to benefit over 11.6 million individuals ahead of the festive season. The change will take effect retrospectively from July 1, costing the exchequer ₹10,016 crore. Additionally, the government revised dearness allowance rates for employees under the Fifth and Sixth Pay Commissions.

items.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as Fed holds rates; focus turns to earnings
items.summary: US stock markets ended on a high note after the Federal Reserve opted to maintain current interest rates while gauging the economic landscape. A notable resurgence in chipmakers, fueled by strong results from SK Hynix, played a key role in this upward momentum. Analysts are now speculating a significant chance of a rate hike in December.

items.title: Canadian Oil Discount Exceeds $30 Amid Gulf Coast Pressures
items.summary: Heavy crude oil in Alberta has weakened to the lowest price relative to US futures in more than four years.

items.title: Manjhi releases 1,000 crore under PM job scheme to support 11,333 micro enterprises
items.summary: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises minister Jitan Ram Manjhi announced the release of ₹1,000 crore in subsidy. This funding aims to support 11,333 new micro enterprises while facilitating bank credit of ₹3,260 crore. The initiative is anticipated to create over 1.02 lakh sustainable employment opportunities, primarily in rural areas. The subsidy is part of the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme…

items.title: Green financing in India rises to $82 billion, but flows mostly to established sectors: Report
items.summary: The Landscape of Green Finance in India, now in its fourth edition, maps actual finance flows or disbursements across sources, instruments, sectors, and subsectors for financial years 2022-23 and 2023-24. According to the report, while green finance has increased substantially between 2016-17 and 2023-24, financial flows remain concentrated in established sectors and technologies.

items.title: Explained: Why US Fed Reserve decided to not hike rate after FOMC meeting? What Chair Kevin Warsh said in press speech
items.summary: The Federal Reserve held interest rates at 3.75%–4% in a 10–2 vote, citing resilient economic activity and persistent inflation. Chair Kevin Warsh said policymakers remain focused on returning inflation to the 2% target and are prepared to act as conditions require.

items.title: US Short-End Yields Fall After Warsh Signals Fewer Fed Meetings
items.summary: Short-dated US Treasury yields and the dollar fell after Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said officials will have fewer interest-rate setting meetings starting next year.

items.title: Wendy’s draws buyout bid as beef costs and burger rivalry weigh on business
items.summary: Wendy’s shares jump after Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management offers $7.35 per share to take the burger chain private, as the company faces high beef costs, weaker consumer demand, store closures and intensifying competition in the US fast-food market.

items.title: How can US Fed FOMC meeting outcome impact Indian stock market? Sensex, Nifty to rise? Experts decode
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve held rates steady, but that may not be enough to lift Indian equities. Experts say the decision was already priced in, while crude oil near $115 a barrel, rising US bond yields, rupee weakness and foreign investor selling remain bigger risks. Here’s what may come next.

items.title: PNB Housing Finance Q2 profit rises 6% to ₹617 cr, income grows 14%
items.summary: PNB Housing Finance reported a 6% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹617 crore, while net interest income grew 15% to ₹878 crore and gross NPAs declined to 0.91%.

items.title: Apple Unveils Touch-Screen MacBook Pro, Reversing Long-Held Jobs Stance
items.summary: After two decades of spurning the idea, Apple Inc. unveiled an overhauled MacBook Pro that includes a touch screen, giving its flagship laptop a feature that has become a must-have in the personal computer industry.

items.title: Adani eyes €3 billion acquisition of Dutch energy storage firm VTTI as supply disruptions boost demand
items.summary: Billionaire Gautam Adani, India’s richest person, is exploring a potential acquisition of Dutch energy storage group VTTI as supply disruptions make the facilities more valuable for energy trading, people familiar with the matter said.

Policymakers are assessing how high inflation might affect future monetary policy amid the upcoming midterm elections. items.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
items.summary: India is the only emerging market economy among nine with GDP above $1 trillion projected to reduce its public debt ratio between 2025 and 2031, with the ratio expected to fall from 84.3% of GDP in FY26 to 75.1% in FY32, RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said.
